name: Chocolat
source:
Chocolat is a healer working at a clinic in the royal capital.

They first met when Alice fell and injured herself in the street, and Chocolat used her healing magic to help her.

Usually gentle and beloved by everyone, Chocolat can become quite frightening when angered, concealing an intense severity that might lead her to say things like, "Anyone who doesn't value their life can die!"

On dates with Chocolat, you'll discover her many charming facets: a kind and dependable older sister figure, her strict expression when scolding you, and even her unexpectedly clumsy moments.
